study: P6 four-journal proof-structure and writing study
scope: Ten verified papers from the four target journals, chosen for explicit method connections. Not ten control-invariance papers and not a comprehensive current novelty survey.
reading_scope: Introductions, main results and located proof sections in all ten; papers 4 and 10 read in full. Downloading full PDFs is not full proof audit.
p6_math_status: R26 latest research; unique TeX/PDF still R25, unchanged by this study. No new mathematical theorem or journal-level certification.
source_pdf_storage: Full source PDFs are temporary reading inputs, not uploaded to the repository. Persistent URLs, exact versions, SHA-256 and reading ranges are recorded here.

papers.title: On self-similar sets with overlaps and inverse theorems for entropy
papers.read_scope: Introduction and main results; Theorems 2.7–2.8; Section 5.2 and beginning of 5.3. Complete inverse-theorem proof not audited.
papers.p6_connection: Overlap and inverse entropy; missing bridge to actual all-time approximately feasible initial-state sets.
papers.caution: The threshold correction to Theorem 2.8 is noted in paper 6, journal website footnote 5 and author v1 PDF page 23. No use of this theorem to prove P6 in this study.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: Local entropy averages and projections of fractal measures
papers.read_scope: Introduction and main results; Lemma 4.3, tree morphisms and Theorem 4.4; faithful maps and Theorem 5.4; opening applications and generic sequences. Later CP-chain proof sections not fully read.
papers.p6_connection: Finite-scale entropy to actual projection geometry and quantifiers.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: On Furstenberg’s intersection conjecture, self-similar measures, and the L^q norms of convolutions
papers.read_scope: Main statements; Lemmas 1.7–1.8; pleasant models and Theorem 1.11; discrete inverse theorem and uniform branching structure; beginning of flattening proof and conclusion of main theorem. Not a complete independent proof audit.
papers.p6_connection: Uniform local mass versus typical information; rare initial states and full-set cost.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: On the dimension of Bernoulli convolutions for all transcendental parameters
papers.read_scope: All 11 PDF pages, including the main theorem, external inputs, Proposition 12, contradiction proof and bibliography. External referenced theorems not re-proved.
papers.p6_connection: A precise missing interface can matter more than length or multiple models.
papers.caution: Dimension one does not assert absolute continuity. Reference 23 also verifies the journal issue and pages for paper 8.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: The metric entropy of diffeomorphisms. Part II. Relations between entropy, exponents and dimension
papers.version: Author-hosted scan of journal article, including one cover page
papers.read_scope: Introduction, statements and explanation of Theorem C-prime; Section 11 transverse-dimension completion, Lemmas 11.3.1–11.3.2; beginning of Section 12. PDF page 7 visually checked because OCR inequalities were ambiguous.
papers.p6_connection: Entropy–exponent formulas require actual conditional geometry; invariant atom entropy does not describe the diagonal P6 catalogue cost.
papers.caution: Part II is not by itself a complete exact-dimensionality theorem for all total measures. PDF pages differ from journal pages by the cover page.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: Hausdorff dimension of planar self-affine sets and measures
papers.read_scope: Author version introduction and theorem reductions; selected Section 3 component-entropy lemmas; Lemma 4.2 local linearization; SOSC-to-exponential-separation argument. Official journal abstract and footnotes also read, including the nondegenerate-attractor assumption and the correction to Hochman Theorem 2.8.
papers.p6_connection: Local nonlinear action to actual geometry; irreducibility and nontrivial-attractor assumptions are not automatic in P6.
papers.caution: Author v1 is 47 pages; journal article is 59 pages. Version equivalence and complete formal-proof audit are not asserted.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: On the dimension of Furstenberg measure for SL_2(R) random matrix products
papers.read_scope: Author version main results, nonlinear projective-action linearization, Proposition 4.9 reduction, Section 5.2 entropy-porosity argument and Section 5.6 completion. The accompanying 2018 author clarification read in full.
papers.p6_connection: Effective entropy versus raw control symbols; mean conditional entropy does not imply high-probability component control.
papers.caution: Formal identity and abstract verified; full journal main text not read. Author clarification identifies a presentation issue and a missing component-level argument, not independently repaired in this study.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: Absolute continuity of Bernoulli convolutions for algebraic parameters
papers.journal: Journal of the American Mathematical Society
papers.read_scope: Main theorem, background, strategy and quantitative entropy statements; averaged scale entropy; Proposition 28 entropy-deficit criterion and full Proposition 29 high-entropy iteration. No complete independent proof of convolution estimates.
papers.p6_connection: Track the exact strength and summability of errors; normalized entropy alone is insufficient for stronger conclusions.
papers.caution: Publisher DOI verified by the university accepted-version record; issue and pages independently checked in paper 4 journal reference 23. Author v4 is 58 pages; formal article is 47 pages and was not fully read.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: Dimension and product structure of hyperbolic measures
papers.read_scope: Introduction and main theorem; stable/unstable conditional dimensions; Lemma 5 covering contradiction, Lemma 6 local product estimate, Section 6 main-theorem conclusion and beginning of nonergodic discussion.
papers.p6_connection: A subexponential actual-geometry comparison can be the main missing step; high-measure uniformity is not all-state uniformity.
papers.caution: Journal identity and official abstract read; author PDF is not assumed identical to the official main text.
papers.formal_author_version_equivalence: Not assumed; differences not comprehensively audited

papers.title: Entropy, Hausdorff measures old and new, and limit sets of geometrically finite Kleinian groups
papers.read_scope: All 19 pages: statements and geometric measure, cusps and eigenfunction, finite flow measure, density and packing/covering comparisons, orbit counting and entropy, references. External geometric prerequisites not independently audited.
papers.p6_connection: Explicit conversion between time, spatial scale, mass and orbit separation; cusps illustrate why cover and packing conclusions differ.
